summary: The supplied desktop and mobile screenshots show minor text wrapping and clipping issues.

findings.description: [defect] In the desktop features grid, the SQL & N+1 card clips its code sample at the right edge, leaving the file and line reference incomplete.
[defect] At 390 px, the hero headline leaves 「い。」 alone on the third line, breaking 「逃さない。」 across lines.
[defect] In the desktop benchmark table, the highlighted Kestrel Trace row splits 「即時起動」 across two lines. The column header also leaves 「動」 alone on its second line.
